name: snapcart-for-woocommerce
description: A live cart icon for your header and a fast add-to-cart confirmation for WooCommerce.
author: Ali Murtaza

scripts.release:patch: node tools/version.mjs patch && npm run build && npm run pot
scripts.release:minor: node tools/version.mjs minor && npm run build && npm run pot
scripts.release:major: node tools/version.mjs major && npm run build && npm run pot
scripts.zip: npm run build && npm run pot && node tools/zip.mjs
